acts.map: Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no logos, readable text, real people or copied websites. Tall vertical overhead papercraft diorama of a windy hilltop weather station, read bottom to top: a forked stone trail and canvas bag at the foot, scattered cream observation sheets and paired glass gauges midway, a tangled kite and yellow light canister higher up, and a white slatted station at the summit. Leave a broad open middle ground for readable path lines; reserve a clear summit platform for the four-legged Unbroken Observer. Teal hexagonal patches creep uphill along the edges.

Wide, subdued fight background: lower hill stone path, wind-bent grass, a distant white gauge shelter and a few loose cream paper sheets. Sparse teal hexagonal growth at the far edges. Open, low-contrast center with no central subject.
